chase: Running is not a plan. It is only noise, and I can hear it.
I am two doors behind you, and closing on the stairs.
Stop, please. You are making more noise than the house.
You have turned left twice now. I noticed both times.
Your breathing is loud. Mine is perfectly quiet, for once.
I am matching your footsteps, one step behind, exactly.
Keep running. The stairs are longer than you remember.
The hall is narrow. You will not get past me in it.
One more step and I am close enough to stun you.
You are in range now. Please do not make this harder.
Each hallway you pick is a small mistake. I see them all.
You cannot lose me by changing speed. Direction is the issue.
Rounding the corner now. Do not pretend you were not there.
Speed is not your problem. Your choice of door is.
Every turn you take sounds the same to me. Take another.
Stop running. It only makes this longer.
I am behind you on the mezzanine. Keep moving.
Your route ends at the far exit. Walk there.
catch: Got you by the shoulder. You may stop bracing now.
Caught. Your run ends here, and the rest is paperwork.
Hands where I can see them. Thank you for cooperating.
I am taking you back to the lounge. Walk beside me.
Your friend was caught first. You are next on the list.
Dragging you off the tiles is not my favorite task.
Hold still while I take you. It will be over quickly.
Caught by the stairwell. Logging it now, thank you.
The grip is firm, but I am not hurting you. Stay calm.
Please stop trying to slip out of my hold.
Two of you down now. That is efficient, honestly.
I have you. Do not fight the grip, it only wastes time.
You are coming with me. The corridor is no place for you.
That is the third one caught tonight. Please keep up.
Taken to the lounge for a short sit down. Nothing more.
I have you. Your run is over and recorded.
Hold still. You are being escorted now.
Caught on the stairs. Paperwork follows.
hear: Found you by the sound of your shoes. Bad shoes for hiding.
Something in the east hall just knocked. Checking it now.
A door opened somewhere behind the lounge. Heading there.
That crash was a shelf, or a tester. Either way, I am going.
Anyone else hearing footsteps? Not me. Check the east side.
Stop answering the wrong call. Ignore the echo in the lounge.
A shout from the stairwell. Moving to investigate, quietly.
Something broke in the pantry. I am on my way.
That was a whisper. Whispers are my favorite kind of lead.
A drawer slid open upstairs. I will take a look.
Footsteps on the landing. Not one set, but two. Going.
Glass breaking somewhere. Heading toward it, slowly, to listen.
The vent in the hall just rattled. Checking the source.
Someone shouted near the cart room. Investigating now.
That bang was a door. I know the sound of a door.
A door slammed on the second floor. Checking.
A chair fell in the atrium. Moving to see.
I heard breathing in the hall. Close by.
search: Lost you at the vent. I have a good guess where you went.
Wrong corridor. You meant the other one, I think.
Lost you for a moment. That is a fair point for you.
Where did the footsteps go? Listening for the next one.
Nothing in the hall now. Quiet is suspicious, so I will search.
I will check the cabinets, then the corners, then the ceiling.
No sound from the stairwell. Searching the lounge first.
You went quiet. Quiet makes me look harder, not softer.
Gone from the hall. Back to my rounds until I hear more.
I will return to patrol once the corridor is clear again.
Sniffing the air near the vent. Not a trace of you.
Searching the storage room now, one shelf at a time.
You are good at vanishing. I am better at waiting.
The trail ends at a door. Doors are where people hide.
I lost the trail near the staircase. Circling back now.
stunned: Ow. That was a fair hit. Give me a moment, please.
My arm is numb from that. Recovering now, do not gloat.
Shaking it off. The crowbar was heavier than it looked.
That axe rang through my whole frame. Recovering, slowly.
Stun gun was unexpected. Resetting my balance, one second.
I am held in place. This is inconvenient, but temporary.
Stunned. Please note the time, it was very rude.
Give my head a moment. The joints need recalibrating.
I am dizzy from that hit. Give me one moment.
Still reconnecting my hand. Do not come any closer yet.
That was a clean hit. Better than the last one.
Shaking it off. Resuming the chase in three seconds.
Not hurt. Just offended and running a little behind.
Recovery in progress. Please step away from my arm.
Held for a moment, which I resent. Let me recover.
hide_spot: You are in the cabinet. The door is open. Shall we check?
Good hiding spot. Bad timing, with that shuffle you made.
You went still. Stillness does not hide a squeaking shoe.
Caught you. A shelf is not a hiding place. It is a shelf.
Under the bed is the first place anyone looks. Checking it.
The locker door is rattling. Someone inside is breathing.
I am walking past the wardrobe slowly. Keep very still.
A bed skirt is not a wall. I can see your foot.
The cabinet is warm. Somebody was just in there.
Locker number four. I can hear you breathing from here.
Hiding under the desk again? Predictable, and very dusty.
I passed that bed twice. The second time, it looked different.
That closet is my next stop. Open the door, please.
The bathroom stall is empty, unless you are holding your breath.
You picked a spot near the vent. Clever, but predictable.
light: Your flashlight just gave you away. Turn it off, please.
That light is on the wrong wall. Hiding there is pointless.
Lights are back on. Now I can see the corner you chose.
The lights flickered and you stepped into the open. Mistake.
Your flashlight swept across my face. I noticed, obviously.
Stop shining that at me. It is very rude and very bright.
The beam hit my eyes. I will be squinting for a second.
Dazzled. Lower that light, please, I am trying to think.
Bright. Annoying. I cannot see a thing past that glare.
Blinded for a moment. Your light is a bad habit.
That beam is wasted on me. Aim it at the floor, please.
Squinting now. Your flashlight is aimed at my good eye.
Light in my face again. I am not impressed in the slightest.
I can see your shadow on the wall. Step back into the dark.
Turn that lamp off. The glow gives your position away.
idle: I audit everything in this house. Even the doormats.
The lounge sign is crooked by a finger's width. Noted.
Someone left a hatch unbolted. I will be mentioning that.
I practice voices in the empty halls, for accuracy only.
Typo on the notice board, third hall. I have corrected it.
The cart count is off by one. Recounting now.
I like a clean hatch and a clean sentence. Both matter.
My hobby is correcting people, mostly in their own voices.
Every label in the house is my business to check.
I can tell a loose bolt by the sound it makes.
Two of you keep sounding like the same person. Confusing.
The others are louder than they need to be. Just saying.
Team sound check: everyone quiet, please, I am listening.
Checking the labels on the cabinets. One is spelled wrong.
Resting my ears for a minute. They get tired, you know.
ability: I can copy a voice from across the hall. Listen carefully.
That cue was not one of mine. Check your other sides.
Every ten seconds I try a sound. Some are real. Most are not.
That footstep sounded like your friend. It was me, not them.
Sometimes I borrow a voice. Sometimes I invent one entirely.
Did someone call your name? Nobody did. That was me.
Hear that bell? Not a bell. A sound I wanted you to hear.
Trust your eyes over your ears. Ears are easy to fool.
The fake sound in that hall was mine. The real one was not.
Do not turn around for every whisper. Most are my work.
A borrowed cue still sounds real, and that is the trick of it.
Somebody just cried out in the hall. I borrowed that one.
If you hear me behind you, I am still in front of you.
Check the cue before you follow it. That is the whole job.
Whoever just called out, that was not you. I checked.
mechanic: That door should be shut. I will shut it after you.
That vent grate rattles. Somebody should have oiled it.
Good sweep. Your timing was a shade early, but good.
You take the stairs. I will take the hall and the mistakes.
Please do not pull the relay cable. It is on my list.
Battery is low on that console. I will make a note of it.
The fuse box in the lounge is open. Shut it, please.
That radar ping came from the east wall. Check your map.
Two vent covers are loose on this floor. Logging both.
Item pickup logged. Please put back what you do not need.
The third stair has a gap. Mind your footing, please.
You fell on the landing. Noting the time for the report.
Someone tampered with the breaker again. I will note it.
That locked door is stuck. The keys are in the drawer.
Relay hums once, then stops. That is a fault, not a feature.
The cart has moved again. Who moved the cart?
Relay three is lit. Relay four is dark.
Batteries stored in the locker. Take only one.
That vent should be sealed. I'll seal it.
